// Reference code (not production): generated from Figma "Brownfield Design" > Library - Podcasts by tools/screen_code.py.
// DS names only (Music App Android design system); colors follow the Light / Dark theme.

import androidx.compose.foundation.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.*
import androidx.compose.ui.res.stringResource

@Composable
fun LibraryPodcastsScreen(navigate: (String) -> Unit) {
    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface)
            .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
    ) {
        StatusBar(time = "5:00", modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
        // Search Section
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing12),
        ) {
            SearchBar(
                placeholder = stringResource(R.string.search_in_your_library),
                iconSearch = AppIcons.Search,
                iconMic = AppIcons.Mic,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
        }
        // Library Tabs
        Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
            // Tabs Row
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            ) {
                PrimaryTabs(
                    firstTab = TabItem(label = stringResource(R.string.music)),
                    secondTab = TabItem(selected = true, label = stringResource(R.string.podcasts_caps)),
                    onChange = { index -> when (index) { 0 -> navigate("library-music"); 1 -> navigate("library-podcasts") } },
                )
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(AppTheme.spacing.spacing12))
                IconButton(icon = AppIcons.Settings)
                IconButton(icon = AppIcons.Help)
            }
            Divider(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
        }
        // Filter Chips
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
        ) {
            FilterChip(selected = true, label = stringResource(R.string.episodes))
            FilterChip(label = stringResource(R.string.shows))
        }
        // Shortcut Tiles
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
        ) {
            LibraryShortcutTile(
                label = stringResource(R.string.saved),
                icon = AppIcons.Bookmark,
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            )
            LibraryShortcutTile(
                color = LibraryShortcutTileColor.Cyan,
                label = stringResource(R.string.downloads),
                icon = AppIcons.CloudDownload,
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            )
            LibraryShortcutTile(
                color = LibraryShortcutTileColor.Magenta,
                label = stringResource(R.string.your_new_podcasts),
                icon = AppIcons.Podcasts,
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            )
        }
        // Continue Playing Header
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
        ) {
            SectionHeader(
                title = stringResource(R.string.continue_playing),
                showMore = false,
                showSupportingText = false,
                supportingText = stringResource(R.string.discover_music_based_on_your_recent),
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
        }
        // Episodes
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
        ) {
            PodcastEpisodeCard(
                description = "In this episode we talk the Brit awards, Zayn's new It's You music video, and our current feelings about the band",
                timeLeft = stringResource(R.string.t_1h_42min_left),
                showDownload = true,
                progressIndicator = ProgressIndicator(value = ProgressIndicatorValue.V10),
                image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1018_10_397),
                title = "Harry Potter and the One Direction - Episode 37 - It's You",
                subtitle = "Talk Direction: The 1D (& Harry Styles) Podcast",
                titleLines = 2,
                hideActiveTrack = true,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
            PodcastEpisodeCard(
                description = "Thank you for listening!! See Privacy Policy at https://art19.com/privacy and California Privacy Notice",
                timeLeft = stringResource(R.string.t_1h_2min_left),
                showDownload = false,
                progressIndicator = ProgressIndicator(value = ProgressIndicatorValue.V10),
                image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1050_10_397),
                title = "Broccoli Guts Pt. 2 | PITM #149",
                subtitle = "PitM",
                titleLines = 2,
                hideActiveTrack = true,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
            PodcastEpisodeCard(
                description = "We are GHR - America's Dance Music Mixshow! This weeks GHR is major! We are \"LIVE\" from COACHELLA",
                timeLeft = stringResource(R.string.t_56min_left),
                showDownload = true,
                progressIndicator = ProgressIndicator(value = ProgressIndicatorValue.V40),
                image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1072_10_397),
                title = "GHR - Show 426 - LIVE from Coachella 2015 - Hour 2",
                subtitle = "Ghetto House Radio",
                titleLines = 2,
                hideActiveTrack = true,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
        }
        BottomNavigation(
            firstItem = NavigationItem(label = stringResource(R.string.explore), icon = AppIcons.Explore),
            secondItem = NavigationItem(label = stringResource(R.string.search), icon = AppIcons.Search),
            thirdItem = NavigationItem(label = stringResource(R.string.connect), icon = AppIcons.Groups),
            fourthItem = NavigationItem(
                selected = true,
                label = stringResource(R.string.your_library),
                icon = AppIcons.LibraryMusic,
            ),
            onChange = { index -> when (index) { 0 -> navigate("explore-viewport"); 1 -> navigate("search-discover-viewport"); 3 -> navigate("library-music") } },
        )
        MiniPlayer(
            image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1132_10_451),
            title = "لو كنت غالى",
            subtitle = "مصطفى قمر",
            onOpen = { navigate("now-playing") },
        )
    }
}
